title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named GCSU places for studying, gathering, performances, recreation and connection, supported by current university pages.

cards.title: Front Campus
cards.subtitle: Historic central lawn at Georgia College & State University
cards.notes: Use the lawn as an outdoor meet-up or break spot, and watch the university calendar for convocations, concerts and other scheduled events.
cards.short_summary: A campus lawn used for leisure activities and major university gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU identifies Front Campus as a gathering space and says it hosts leisure activities, convocations, graduations and outdoor concerts.
cards.source_title: Our proud traditions | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted university event and access guidance.

cards.title: The Bobcat Head
cards.subtitle: Front Campus crossroads
cards.notes: Make this marble mascot marker a group-photo stop while crossing Front Campus; respect the university’s documented graduation-related tradition around it.
cards.short_summary: A marble mascot depiction and recognized spot for group pictures.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU describes the Bobcat Head as a marble depiction of its mascot at the Front Campus crossroads and a popular place for group pictures.
cards.source_title: Our proud traditions | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor marker on Front Campus; do not chalk, paint or write on or near it.

cards.title: Ina Dillard Russell Library
cards.subtitle: Main campus library
cards.notes: Start research here by reserving a study room, arranging a research consultation or checking out technology through the library’s listed services.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines research help, study-room reservations and technology checkout.
cards.evidence_claim: Russell Library lists research consultations, technology checkout and study room reservations among services for the campus community.
cards.source_title: Ina Dillard Russell Library | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours and reservation requirements before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Russell Library Second Floor Computing Area
cards.title: Russell Library Second Floor Computing Area
cards.subtitle: Ina Dillard Russell Library
cards.notes: Use this named computing area when a campus desktop is more useful than a laptop; it provides both Windows and Mac workstations.
cards.short_summary: A library computer area with Windows and Mac stations.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU IT lists 47 Windows seats and four Mac OS seats in the Russell Library Second Floor Computing Area.
cards.source_title: Student Technology Resources | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on open seats and library access; follow library computer-use rules.

cards.title: Russell Library First Floor Atrium
cards.subtitle: Ina Dillard Russell Library
cards.notes: Choose the atrium for a quick campus-computer session near the library entrance; GCSU lists six Windows seats in this specific area.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library work area with six listed Windows computer seats.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU IT identifies the Russell Library First Floor Atrium as a Windows computer resource with six seats.
cards.source_title: Student Technology Resources | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on open seats and library access; follow library computer-use rules.

cards.title: Blackbridge Hall
cards.subtitle: 111 S Clarke St., Milledgeville
cards.notes: Visit the Office of Community Engagement and Belonging here to ask about volunteer opportunities, service-learning resources and belonging programs.
cards.short_summary: A heart-of-campus home for community-engagement and student-belonging resources.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU says its Office of Community Engagement and Belonging is located in Blackbridge Hall and connects students with partnerships and programs.
cards.source_title: Office of Community Engagement & Belonging | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Contact the office for program details and availability.

cards.title: Wellness and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 134 West Campus Drive
cards.notes: Use the WRC for fitness, free-play sports, wellness programs and organized recreation; bring your Bobcat ID and confirm eligibility before entry.
cards.short_summary: A West Campus recreation hub with fitness, sports and wellness programming.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU describes the WRC as a West Campus hub offering fitness, organized intramural and club sports, free-play sports and wellness options.
cards.source_title: Wellness & Recreation | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Controlled access; current enrolled students who pay applicable building and health fees may use the facility.

cards.title: Rec Fields
cards.subtitle: Behind the Wellness and Recreation Center, West Campus
cards.notes: Look for intramural or club-sport schedules that use these fields, then join a team or watch a tournament through the appropriate program.
cards.short_summary: A 10.5-acre field complex used for games and tournaments.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU says the Rec Fields sit on 10.5 acres behind the WRC and host an array of games and tournaments.
cards.source_title: Intramurals - Recreational Sports | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to recreational-sports scheduling and facility rules.

cards.title: Russell Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Georgia College campus
cards.notes: Check Theatre and Dance announcements for productions and performances in this historic auditorium, then confirm ticketing or reservation details before attending.
cards.short_summary: The university’s principal performance space for music and theatre productions.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU identifies Russell Auditorium as the main performance space for music and theatre productions.
cards.source_title: Production Facilities - Theatre & Dance | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent; check the department’s current production and ticket information.

cards.title: Campus Black Box Theatre
cards.subtitle: Campus Theatre, 137 W. Hancock St., downtown Milledgeville
cards.notes: See the current Theatre and Dance season for performances in this flexible-seating venue, and use the department’s ticket link for attendance details.
cards.short_summary: A downtown black-box venue for theatre performance, rehearsal and classroom work.
cards.evidence_claim: GCSU says the Campus Theatre includes a black box theatre with flexible seating, rehearsal and classroom space for its theatre department.
cards.source_title: Production Facilities - Theatre & Dance | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent; Campus Theatre is at 137 W. Hancock St. in historic downtown Milledgeville.
